A complete 15-level signed-partition-function magnitude spectrum exposes the exact rank defect, first 96 two-edge Fourier cancellations, min positive singular value 8, and sharp optimal endpoint projection amplification 2597417/32768. These naturally measure recovery stability of the full matching-indicator convolution and are not implied by the known unsigned count or a few toroidal homology sectors.
